edit.description: `gate` reads lock.toml twice per run: `drift::read_declarations(workspace)` (:151) and `drift::read_lock_document(workspace)` (:154). Derive `committed` from the one parsed `lock_doc` through a new `pub(crate) drift::declarations_from_doc` face, and correct the comment at :148-150 that already claims 'this is the gate's one read of it'.

`read_declarations` (:4650) reads and parses lock.toml through `fs::read_to_string` + `parse_declarations` and increments neither `LOCK_READS` nor `LOCK_PARSES`, so the count pin is blind to it. Route it through the counted door (`read_lock_document` + the existing private `declarations_from_doc` at :4691) and widen that helper to `pub(crate)` for gate.rs. `parse_declarations` keeps its embedded-text face (`builtin_lock`).

The existing lock pins cover `emit` (:251) and a hand-simulated gate over `_from_doc` variants (:312) — neither drives the real `gate()`. Add the pin over a real `gate()` run; it reads 2/2 on the pre-fix tree once `read_declarations` counts, and 1/1 after.

summary: `gate` reads and parses lock.toml twice per run, and the count pin sees only one door: `read_declarations` increments neither counter.

per.section: Cost scale is hoisted, and pinned by count

tests.asserts: Across one real `gate()` over a represented harness, `drift::lock_read_count` and `drift::lock_parse_count` each advance by exactly 1 — with the non-vacuity assertion that the run judged at least one member, so a gate that read nothing cannot pass the count.
The existing emit pin (one read, one parse per `emit` run) and the hoisted source-dependency pin stay green — routing `read_declarations` through the counted door moves no emit-side count.

acceptance: `cargo test` green, including the new real-`gate()` lock pin at one read and one parse; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
notes: Measured on disk this tick: gate.rs:151 and :154 are two disk reads and two TOML parses of the same file per check run, and lock_read_count/lock_parse_count report 1 because read_declarations increments nothing — the pin's green is blind, not earned. Session-open `check` pays it on every tick. scoped at e667d9ed
